{{Weapon infobox | description = {{flavor|This weapon is used to craft the legendary torch [[Rodgort]].

Combine this weapon in the Mystic Forge with:
• 1 Gift of Rodgort
• 1 Gift of Mastery
• 1 Gift of Fortune}} | type = Torch | prefix = Berserker's | uslot = Superior Sigil of Rage | level = 80 | skin = Rodgort's Flame (skin); Rodgort's Flame (original skin); Rodgort's Flame Experiment (skin) | rarity = exotic | collection = Legendary Weapon: Rodgort | bound = use | salvage = none | set = Precursor weapons | id = 29182 }} [[Rodgort's Flame]] is an [[exotic]] level 80 [[torch]] and the [[precursor weapon]] for [[Rodgort]]. == Acquisition == === Recipe === * Crafted once per account after completing the [[Rodgort III: Rodgort's Flame]] collection. {{recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Box of Recipes: Rodgort's Flame | type = Legendary Component | disciplines = huntsman | rating = 500 | ingredient1 = 1 Essence of Burning | ingredient2 = 1 Spirit of the Perfected Torch | ingredient3 = 1 Everburning Flame | ingredient4 = 1 Dragon Statue | id = 11076 }} === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Other === {{exotic weapon text}} == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Notes == * The [[Game_updates/2019-06-25|June 25th, 2019]] update added a [[Holographic Flame|holographic version of this weapon]] to the game. == Trivia == * The name of this weapon is in reference to the skills [[gww:Rodgort's Invocation|Rodgort's Invocation]] and [[gww:Mark of Rodgort|Mark of Rodgort]] from the original Guild Wars. * Rodgort spelled backwards is [[w:Trogdor|Trogdor]], which is the name of a dragon from one of the [[w:Home Star Runner|Homestar Runner]] cartoons. * A [[Bringer's Wrapped Torch|"gift-wrapped" version]] of this skin can be found as part of the [[Wrapped weapons]] set. {{Precursor weapons nav|1|Rodgort's Flame}} [[Category:Precursor weapons]] [[de:Rodgort-Flamme]] [[es:Llama de Rodgort]] [[fr:Flamme de Rodgort]]
title: Rodgort's Flame
